quote: LensVLM-9B is a vision-language model that scans compressed images of text and selectively expands relevant pages. Card names Qwen3.5-9B as base, Transformers image-text-to-text, and separates research-only model license from source-code license.

License Scope grants use exclusively for Research Purposes, defined as non-commercial scientific research and academic development; it explicitly excludes commercial exploitation, product development, or use in a commercial product/service. Applies to model derivatives as well.

Paper trains Qwen3.5-9B-Base with supervised traces and reinforcement learning. Model sees all compressed pages of selected context and sequentially expands indexed pages. Headline ECR 4.3x near full-text baseline and up to 10.1x versus compared baselines is token/context evidence, not end-to-end speed. Text expansion preferred for rendered text, high-resolution image expansion useful for native document layouts. Appendix 10 reports ~17s vs ~8s at batch 1, 256 generation tokens on B200 for typical one expansion; measured final-turn KV occupancy falls 78.6% for 20 images and 84.2% for 100 under TP=8. Rendering and sequential inference cost time.

Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with bfloat16, 32 language-model layers, full attention interval 4, max_position_embeddings 262144, hybrid linear/full attention. Configuration context ceiling is not a measured QA quality envelope or hardware-fit guarantee.

Source code license separately grants use, reproduction, modification and redistribution subject to notice/disclaimer terms; no explicit patent rights and no Apple endorsement rights. It is not the research-only weights license.

Root demo.py accepts a custom text file/question and 5x/10x/15x presets; scripts/run_demo.py runs bundled QA example. Evaluation includes an LLM judge; README uses Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 on 8 B200 GPUs for the judge, not a requirement for merely running the 9B demo.

Normalization collapses internal whitespace, paragraph boundaries and code indentation. Optional original-character to normalized-character map is used to map supplied ground-truth evidence spans into pages. PageRenderResult returns rendered page_texts and evidence_pages, not original source line ranges; expansion text is line-wrapped normalized text.

Default max_turns 6, generation cap 2048 per turn. parse_tool_call regex extracts page numbers and has a permissive page-key fallback. _build_tool_response indexes supplied page_texts/images_hires and returns None for out-of-range indices. No nearby-file discovery or episodic-history tools.
Source requires torch>=2.13.0, vllm>=0.27.0, transformers>=5.10.0, Pillow>=12.3.0 and datasets>=2.14. These dependencies are not already implied by llame Node/pnpm setup.

Missing worker structured error; plain reads unchanged. Latest owner comment reserves q/question for second-model analysis and jq/select for deterministic queries. Nearby-file and chat-history exploration are not part of listed bounded-source acceptance.

Question-focused bulk-read delegation precedes loading full corpus into primary context. Reported main-context savings do not establish total billed cost or equivalent success; sources require exact line/value verification. Each source and worker provider egress must be authorized.

read image?q resolves a vision-capable model through vision/default/active preferences then other available vision models; one-shot image+question completion with own prompt, timeout/parent abort and usage/model return. Not a nearby-file or episodic tool loop.

Existing web parser treats query/fragment colons as URL text and does not split line selectors when a query or fragment is present. A new generic ?q parser must not steal legitimate website query parameters or silently change fetched URL.

Native file tools project kb/skill locators to canonical logical identity for permission matching; web projection uses same parser as read, preserving fetched URL and selector. Resolved host paths do not substitute for logical identity.

Ordinary stored replay is bounded over the serialized call/result pair at 8,000 JavaScript UTF-16 units per pair and 32,000 per stored assistant turn. Payloads clear oldest-first when doing so shrinks the envelope; irreducible oldest complete pairs may be dropped. This can clear a large source while preserving a smaller helper answer, so repeated-request economics must use post-projection residency rather than assume carry across Runs.
